capabilities.description: Host type -> CompanionSpec declaration read by every consumer
CameraComponent gets a generated EditorGizmo body entity (mesh + unlit)
Point/directional light billboard moved onto a generated child entity
Per-view feature mask filter in one bucket-binding funnel
Global override drawing gizmos in game-like views
Companions selectable but not editable (inspector, hierarchy, manipulator)
Companions never written to the scene file or cloned
Release pack drops EditorOnly companions and their assets
A host-side billboard from an older scene file is dropped when the icon moves to the companion
ModelInstantiationSystem routes its children through CompanionManager
The camera preview View renders into its own image and the GUI stacks it as viewport chrome, so world overlays stay under it
World interaction asks the host's hit test, so a point on chrome (the preview panel) is not mapped into world coordinates
A generated body follows its host when the host moves through reflection/undo/load, not only through setters
The camera body is a lit solid (Phong), not a flat unlit tint
